intersections.note: Bruce comes from the east and ends at Kirby (its water pipe turns into Kirby); Kirby continues NNW north of Bruce (lots 4312, 4317) to the top edge

unnamed 50 ft street running NNW from the north side of Bruce to the top edge, on Ennis's line but offset about 50 ft west of it; no name on this sheet or the key map (key map shows it running north to Glenparker)
Ennis runs SSE from the south side of Bruce; Bruce continues ENE to the right
Ennis ends at the west end of Pullan; its west face turns south into Pitts' west face at (5917, 5220)
Pitts (40 ft) runs south from Pullan; Pullan runs ENE off the sheet
printed ELLA AV., runs east from Pitts; no width printed (drawn about 40 ft)
printed GORDON in the gap between the blocks south of Chase (x 3635-3885); runs south only

bends.note: Kirby runs NNW-SSE (slope ~0.55) from the top edge through Bruce and turns due south here

ends.note: street outline closed across Florida at its north end (lot 4246); same closure on sheet 629

notes: North is up. Florida Av. runs down the left edge (west face x~220), Kirby Av. (60 ft) down the middle, Ennis Av. (50 ft) diagonally from Bruce to Pullan, then Pitts Av. (40 ft) south from Pullan to Chase and beyond; Chase Av. along the bottom. Kirby is 60 ft south of the bend and drawn about 50 ft north of it (no label there). At Bruce the unnamed street from the north (T at x 4153) and Ennis from the south (T at x 4457) are offset by about one street width. Bruce widens and turns a little more to the north-east east of Ennis (not recorded as a bend). The long single diagonal line from the top left to the Kirby/Bruce corner and the diagonal line from Kirby to Ennis below the Bruce lots are lot lines, not streets. Pullan and Ella have no printed width.
